{"answer":"Based on my search through the context filesystem, I found the answer to your question in the KIP-1266 discussion.

## Answer

The project proposes to **gate the introduction of new tombstone semantics and additional record fields by using the cluster metadata version**. 

According to the discussion in the KIP-1266 thread, specifically in Lijun Tong's response dated January 20, 2026:

> "The solution I have in mind is this feature is *gated by the metadata version*. The new tombstone semantics and the additional fields (for example in RemoteLogSegmentUpdateRecord) are only enabled once the cluster metadata version is upgraded to the version that introduces this feature. As long as the cluster metadata version is not bumped, the system will not produce tombstone records. Therefore, during rolling upgrades (mixed 4.2/4.3 brokers), the feature remains effectively disabled. Tombstones will only start being produced after the metadata version is upgraded, at which point all brokers are already required to support the new behavior."

This mechanism ensures that:
1. During rolling upgrades with mixed broker versions, the new tombstone semantics and fields remain disabled
2. Once the cluster metadata version is upgraded, all brokers are guaranteed to support the new behavior
3. The system will not produce tombstone records unless the metadata version explicitly supports it
